scrubContract.acceptedScenePolicy: Use the additive assets/video/scrub/{desktop,mobile} MP4/WebM derivatives and pair them with the unchanged accepted poster.
scrubContract.newScenePolicy: The new production-path MP4/WebM files already satisfy the scrub contract and pair with their new final-frame posters.

visualQualityControl.method: Reviewed source and production full-frame contact sheets plus enlarged localized crops at representative points from 0 through 5.5 seconds.

barrelHousePanMobile.sourceIssue: Small centered labeled bottle at the vanishing point.
barrelHousePanMobile.selectedRemediation: One constant, narrow delogo rectangle after target normalization; no barrel faces or architecture are broadly blurred.
barrelHousePanMobile.result: Labeled bottle removed in all sampled frames.

barrelHousePseudoStampReview.finding: Barrel-head markings read as generic low-contrast cooperage texture. No legible wordmark, real logo, or OCR-readable brand was observed.

oceanWineVoyageMobile.sourceIssue: Small gold crown and white hull glyph.
oceanWineVoyageMobile.selectedRemediation: Two independently tracked localized delogo rectangles enabled only while the marks are visible; wake, barrels, rail, and hull silhouette remain outside the masks.
oceanWineVoyageMobile.result: Both baked glyphs removed in all sampled visible frames without broad wake blur.

oceanWineVoyageDesktop.sourceIssue: Two linked-ring/circle glyphs baked onto the dark hull; source aspect is approximately 4:3.

preserveContentComposition.foreground: Complete source frame scaled to 1440x1080 and centered at x=240, y=0.
preserveContentComposition.ambientFill: A separately scaled cover copy fills 1920x1080, Gaussian blurred at sigma 32, darkened by 0.10, and desaturated to 0.72.

oceanWineVoyageDesktop.selectedRemediation: Two 24x18 foreground-coordinate delogo masks track the individual glyphs with piecewise-linear half-second samples. Each mask is 0.0278% of the 1440x1080 foreground; both together are 0.0417% of the final canvas.
oceanWineVoyageDesktop.comparison: Broad static union masks, broad removelogo masks, and large clone patches were rejected because enlarged crops showed visible hull smearing or damaged neighboring detail. The selected independent tracked masks are the narrowest reviewed treatment that fully removes both glyphs while preserving the red stripe, porthole, hull line, and full source composition.
oceanWineVoyageDesktop.result: Both baked glyphs removed across the clip; full source frame remains visible over restrained ambient side fill.
